correctness_argument: GeneEssentialityPhenotype is one boolean, is_essential, and five stores write it meaning five different observations (issue #924). Baba 2006 (construction_outcome): no deletion with two or more PCR-verified KmR colonies, which the paper calls 'candidates for essential genes'. Gerdes 2003 (genetic_footprinting): no disruptive insertion recovered after 23 doublings of a pooled fermentor culture. Goodall 2018 (tradis_insertion_index): the low mode of a TraDIS insertion index at a 12-fold likelihood ratio, which the paper says includes 'a very severe fitness cost'. Price 2018 (rb_tnseq_coverage_and_fitness): no fitness value and both normalized TnSeq densities under 0.2, 'essential or important for growth (nearly essential)' at a stated 6% to 16% FDR. SGD (curated_null_phenotype): a curated inviable null phenotype. Baba 2006 states why the difference matters: 'Because genetic footprinting measures cell populations, a mutation causing slow growth can lead to under-representation of the mutant and hence false classification of many genes as essential.' Measured on the dev stores (experiments/036-dataset-fixes-before-kg-build/scripts/essentiality_call_agreement_baba2006_gerdes2003.py, 2026-10-10): Baba and Gerdes share 3,551 loci and agree at Cohen's kappa 0.43, 47 Baba-only and 389 Gerdes-only essential calls; Baba and Goodall TL agree at kappa 0.80. Before this change a consumer pooling essentiality could not tell the evidence apart, and every is_essential=True phenotype of every store dumped to the same dict, so the graph served one phenotype node for all of them. The change adds a required, typed descriptor, GeneEssentialityEvidence: a two-level evidence type (EssentialityEvidenceClass mutant_recovery / insertion_depletion / curated_annotation, the physical observation; EssentialityEvidenceType, the readout and rule, each with exactly one parent in ESSENTIALITY_EVIDENCE_CLASS), the source's own statements typed by role (exactly one scoring_rule, exactly one call_definition, the source's caveats, the definitions of the statistics), each a verbatim SourcedValue with sha256 under the one name 'provenance', and the per-record statistics each release carries (Baba's verified / tested / percent; Gerdes's call letter, insertions and assertion error, value, bound or typed gap; Goodall's call, insertion index and log likelihood ratio; Price's five Table S1 coverage columns and the FDR range; SGD's experiment type), each optional by construction because it belongs to one evidence type and is refused on any other (ESSENTIALITY_EVIDENCE_FIELDS). is_essential keeps its type, default and meaning. The field is required, not optional: every store that writes the class sources it from its own paper (the five loaders fill it, quotes audited verbatim), so no served record is left unsourceable. The new phenotype validator refuses only an incoherent record, a released call letter that disagrees with the boolean or has none (footprinting X or ?, TraDIS 'unclear'); those calls are graded, the loaders already ledger them under counted rules, and a graded leaf (#909) is the sibling slot under Phenotype that would carry this same descriptor. Breaking for the five stores and for the served GeneEssentialitySgdDataset; lands with the KG 4.0 full rebuild.

alternatives_rejected.alternative: A separate phenotype leaf per evidence type (a construction-outcome leaf, an insertion-depletion leaf, a curated leaf)
alternatives_rejected.why_rejected: The released quantity is the same boolean call in all five stores, so by the policy's Rule 6 case 1 the leaf is shared and the divergence is typed beside it; five leaves would move the served SGD records off their class and split every consumer of 'gene essentiality phenotype' (label policy, the essentiality-to-fitness converter, Cooper 2010's flag) across five classes. The evidence class and type carry the DAG instead, two levels deep, and a graded call (#909), a different released quantity, keeps the sibling-leaf route.

alternatives_rejected.alternative: An optional free-text evidence string or an optional descriptor on GeneEssentialityPhenotype
alternatives_rejected.why_rejected: Optional would let a new store write is_essential with no evidence, which is the gap #924 closes, and a string is not queryable or checkable. Every current store can source the descriptor from its own paper, so the field is required.

alternatives_rejected.alternative: Loosen is_essential to bool | None to store Gerdes's X and ? and Goodall's 'unclear' calls
alternatives_rejected.why_rejected: Loosening a required field and changing what the boolean denotes needs owner sign-off (policy Rule 3) and would make every boolean consumer handle a third state; the graded calls are a different released quantity and belong on the graded sibling (#909).

alternatives_rejected.alternative: Keep the evidence in each store's preprocess/calls.csv and the dataset notes (the state before this change)
alternatives_rejected.why_rejected: The evidence then never reaches a record, a graph node or a consumer that pools stores; the per-call statistics stay off the record they qualify.
